description: Interventions: trigger. Spend arena tokens to drop an intervention into a live match. Validates match liveness, match opt-in, game legality, caps, cooldowns and the escalated price BEFORE debiting; a rejection never debits and comes back as a record with status 'rejected' + reject_reason. Applied at the next tick boundary (v1: settled on the next interventions call / overlay feed read); auto-refunded in full if the match ends first. Token-spend only — no real-money path exists in v1 (payment_ref stays null). Optional chat args (viewer_type='chat', platform, chat_user) run the same path through the chat-identity map: an unlinked chat user can never be debited (LINK_REQUIRED). Example: intervention_trigger {"match_id":"<match_id>","code":"<code>"}
